claims.content: The MSIU Field Office User registers a VSP staff member by capturing their details and necessary master information in the system.

goal.raw_text: The MSIU Field Office User registers a VSP staff member by capturing their details and necessary master information in the system.

claims.content: MSIU Field Office User
A 'Staff Type Master' must exist in the system containing a list of staff types from which the user can select.
The MSIU Field Office User initiates the registration of a VSP staff member while capturing staff details during claim entry or when creating new staff under a VSP.

trigger.raw_text: The MSIU Field Office User initiates the registration of a VSP staff member while capturing staff details during claim entry or when creating new staff under a VSP.

claims.content: The MSIU Field Office User captures VSP staff details including VSP Name, Staff Code, Staff Name, Staff Type, and Qualification while entering the claim into the system.
The system automatically creates the Staff Code with a suffix as VSP Code + SC + 3 digits (e.g., HP0001SC0001).
The user selects the Staff Type from the list of staff types available in the Staff Type Master.
If the required staff type is not available, the system allows the user to navigate quickly to the staff type master to enter the new staff type and then return to the Staff Master screen.
All information fields other than Qualification are mandatory during the creation of new staff under any VSP.
If the required staff type is not available in the system, the user can navigate quickly to the Staff Type Master to enter the new staff type and then return to the Staff Master screen.
If the user attempts to create a new staff member with an existing name, the system generates a message but allows the user to save the new staff if required.
The VSP staff member's details (VSP Name, Staff Code, Staff Name, Staff Type, Qualification) are successfully captured and stored in the system.
The system has automatically generated a Staff Code following the format: VSP Code + 'SC' + 3 digits (e.g., HP0001SC0001).
The Staff Type assigned to the new staff member is selected from the existing Staff Type Master list.
